title: Burn ICU: 22% TBSA flame burn with smoke inhalation and burn wound sepsis
diagnosis: Thermal burn 22% TBSA, inhalation injury, ventilator, burn wound sepsis (3-day ICU stay, then Med-Surg)
desc: 3-day Burn ICU stay (Mon 04:00 to Thu 07:00): Parkland resuscitation, intubation and sedation, escharotomy, day-2 burn wound infection with sepsis and norepinephrine, extubation on day 3, transfer to Med-Surg.
